status: analytical screening instrument; not a validated risk score

points.test: Platform and supply-chain provenance/integrity evidence exists.
Data provenance, validation, and access controls are evidenced.
Agent/orchestration authority and tool-use controls are evidenced.
Interface input/output validation and identity/provenance controls are evidenced.
Application-level authorization, policy, and governance evidence is available.
Infrastructure-to-platform trust boundary is tested for integrity/provenance continuity.
Platform-to-data boundary preserves access control and lineage assumptions.
Data-to-model boundary tests poisoning, provenance, and training/evaluation assumptions.
Model-to-orchestration boundary tests adversarial context and tool/agent behavior.
Orchestration-to-interface boundary tests identity, authority, and trajectory logging.
Interface-to-application boundary tests output validation and application authorization.
